title: Product formation and enantiomeric preference in a nickel-catalyzed benzothiazole–bicyclobutane reaction
difficulty_reasons: A connected molecular reaction account and an enantiomeric prediction must be supported by actual independent computation.
Catalyst/ligand model choices, ionic bookkeeping and stereochemical mapping require scientific judgment.
Evidence must support physical explanations without assuming a particular pathway, descriptor or unique computational method.

paper.title: Lewis acid catalyzed enantioselective dearomative (3+2) cycloaddition of aromatic N-heterocycles with bicyclobutanes

data.description: Neutral reactant/catalyst/ligand identities, reaction conditions, ordinary product connectivity and experimental yield/er for the single specified system.
